summary: AuthHeader() normalizes the credential to Clarify's `api-key <key>` Authorization scheme when the raw key is supplied.
reason: Clarify rejects Bearer and raw-key Authorization values; the apiKey security scheme sends the configured value verbatim, so the scheme prefix must be added client-side.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood 185/185 against a real workspace with CLARIFY_API_KEY holding the raw key.
